artworks.title: Horseman
artworks.description: This print shows a horse with a rider. The horse appears to be in motion, facing the left, its legs bent and its tail flowing. The rider is wearing a hat and a long coat, and they are pointing off to the right with one finger extended. They appear to have a long beard, but we can't see much of their face.

artworks.title: The Fall of Man
artworks.description: The image depicts two nude figures on boats holding flags. A tree with garlands and draped elements is central, flanked by the bowing figures. Birds perch on stylized branches above, with swirling lines indicating water below. Swans swim in these lines, adding movement. The design is ornate and symmetrical with intricate details.

artworks.title: Essau Selling his Birthright
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate decorative design with mythological and hunting themes. The central composition features two mirrored figures seated on either side of a large urn, each holding a baton and surrounded by mythical creatures and animals such as lions and birds. Flanking this central motif are two smaller scenes depicting hunters with dogs pursuing a deer on the left and a stag on the right. The scene is highly decorative, with intricate swirls, foliage motifs, and a symmetry typical of Renaissance design. This piece blends naturalistic elements with fantastical aspects, displaying a combination of order and whimsy.

artworks.title: The Deluge
artworks.description: The image features intricate and swirling lines forming an elaborate and symmetrical design. A central focus resembles a theatrical set piece with ornate drapery and a raised platform. On either side are creatures blending human and animal features among scroll-like patterns. Above are candles and hanging ornaments resembling chandeliers, creating a theatrical atmosphere. The creatures, along with figures holding branches and musical instruments, suggest mythical beings or sea creatures, connecting the artwork to ancient tales or fantastical narratives.

artworks.title: Incest of Loth
artworks.description: The image depicts a central pyramid-like structure with concentric rings, surrounded by swirling and curved shapes. There are flames and smoke engulfing objects resembling books or tablets at the base. Two figures are shown in a grotto-like space beneath the pyramid, with winged creatures flying near the top.

artworks.title: Sacrifice of Abraham
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting two figures on a stepped platform. One figure holds a torch and the other holds a bundle of sticks. On top of the platform is a decorative object emitting smoke. Below are two winged serpent-like creatures with human heads, animals, and a figure with a hat holding the reins of a horse. The drawing features ornate swirling lines and plant motifs.

artworks.title: Death of Abel
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a central tableau with ornate decorations and symbolic elements. A goat-headed figure interacts with a reclining human-like figure under an arch adorned with hanging beads and stylized plant motifs. On both sides are arrangements of urns spewing flames. Below are seated figures on textured spheres, with curling scrollwork and stylized waves. The composition is reminiscent of Mannerist artistic styles, focusing on mythical beings and decorative artistry.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.description: This print depicts an ornate emblem. The emblem shows a central oval of text surrounded by several curved sections that contain decorations. At the very top is a face with an ornate headdress, with two winged women holding branch-like objects on either side of the central oval. Below the oval is a nude man seen from the waist up, and on either side of him are two cherubic faces surrounded by scrollwork. The background of the emblem is black, with the details in beige. Surrounding the print is empty beige paper.

artworks.title: Judith with the Head of Holofernes
artworks.description: This drawing features an ornate decorative design with a central human figure. The central element shows a standing figure surrounded by intricate patterns and motifs, including floral designs and mythical creatures. The figure is framed by an arch and appears to be in a classical or mythological pose. The design includes swirling patterns and symbolic objects like a drum. The drawing conveys a sense of elegance and classic beauty reminiscent of Renaissance or Baroque styles.

artworks.title: Mercury with the Head of Argus
artworks.description: This print shows an ornate motif with a person in the center. Surrounding the person are intricate decorative elements like floral motifs, birds, mythical creatures, swirls, vases, and busts of faces. All of the designs are in white against a black background. The person in the center is a partially nude man with wings on his ankles and helmet and a cloak over his shoulders, and he holds a staff with two entwined snakes in one hand and what appears to be a decapitated head in the other. Above him are birds and vases with flowers, and below him are three faces, two with pointed ears and one with long hair. The overall composition is symmetrical, resembling a decorative plate or shield. Around the design is a wide border of beige paper.

artworks.title: Minerva Standing
artworks.description: This shows a black and white drawing with an elaborate design featuring a central figure. The drawing includes a standing figure within a cross-shaped border adorned with intricate scrolls and floral patterns. Above the figure is a bird or eagle-like creature with wings spread. Urns or vases are placed on either side of the arch, with additional bird figures nearby. The background has a textured surface, enhancing the contrast and detail of the dark ink work against the lighter backdrop. The composition suggests a focus on classical or mythological themes, blending human and ornamental elements.

artworks.title: Diana Standing
artworks.description: This print shows an ornate design featuring three people in the center. In the middle is a woman with a long, draped dress and curling hair, holding a bow in one hand and what may be a cylindrical quiver in the other. She is surrounded by two smaller people who appear to have the legs of goats and the bodies of humans, with horned heads. Above and below these people are decorative, curling lines showing vines and flowering branches, with the heads and bodies of two horses visible at the bottom, surrounded by what appear to be curling waves. The people and shapes in the design are off-white against a dark, cross-hatched background, while the area outside of the design is off-white paper.

artworks.title: Mars
artworks.description: This is a print of an emblem or crest. The crest features a central man dressed in armor, holding a shield and a sword. On his head is a curving helmet, and he looks up and to the left. Above this man is an eagle with spread wings. On either side of the eagle are two animals that look like foxes or wolves. Below the armored man, there is intricate scrollwork and leafy designs. Two lions' heads are on each side of the bottom of the emblem, facing the central man with their tongues extended.

artworks.title: Hercules
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate decorative frame with a classical motif. The central figure is a standing person swathed in drapery, with an elegant and poised posture, surrounded by intricate scrollwork and foliage designs. At the top of the frame, two cherubs recline on either side of an urn overflowing with flowers. Beneath them, mythical birds are entwined with the vines depicted in the elaborate design. The overall style of the artwork is richly detailed and reminiscent of classical or Renaissance ornamentation, likely crafted to embellish a printed work.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.description: This is a drawing with an ornamental design featuring human figures and floral motifs. It has a symmetrical layout with human figures on opposite sides of an oval cartouche. The inscription in the cartouche reads "STEPHANUS DE LAVNE INVENTOR EXCIDEBAT ANNO D 1573 IN ARGENTINA." Above the inscription, there is a mask-like face with scrolls and plant motifs. The lower section includes two cherubic figures holding scrolls. The illustration showcases a mixture of human and vegetal forms in a decorative arrangement.

artworks.title: Head of Medusa
artworks.description: This engraving shows an ornamental design with symmetrical features. At the top, two winged humanoid figures face each other, holding up a decorative canopy resembling a tent. Between them, under the tent, a vase containing three large flowers sits on a thin tiered surface. Below this surface is a smiling human head with snakes on top of it and wings emerging from either side. Twisting lines appear from the bottom of the face, and it is surrounded by swirling lines. At the bottom, the heads of two animals face one another; they appear to be dogs with large plumes of feathers emerging from their heads. These heads are surrounded by more curving lines and some small circles. The designs of this engraving appear in white, while the background of the ornament is black. Outside of the ornament, the background is blank, tan paper.

artworks.title: Arabesque Designs
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate design with intricate patterns and two birds. The image features a symmetrical design with swirling floral elements, decorative flourishes, and two birds facing each other. The drawing is dominated by a central intricate motif with scrolling foliage. At the top of the composition is a small decorative element resembling a stylized canopy or umbrella. The design is surrounded by a complex border.

artworks.title: Mars
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate emblem featuring a detailed central figure. The design shows a classical warrior figure surrounded by decorative elements including scrollwork, mythical creatures, and floral motifs. The emblem has a symmetrical framework. At the top, a small face appears. The artwork exhibits characteristics of Renaissance ornamental engravings with delicate lines and detailed patterns.

artworks.title: Neptune
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative heraldic shield. The image features an ornate design centered around a standing figure holding a trident. The central figure is surrounded by an elaborate frame with symmetrical ornate elements resembling curled foliage, volutes, and scrolls. Stylized fish are on either side of the figure, while below, two sea creature-like forms are symmetrically positioned. The drawing is intricately detailed, utilizing ornamental motifs in a monochromatic color scheme with a strong emphasis on contrast and symmetry.

artworks.title: Orlando in a Fury Tearing up Trees
artworks.description: This print shows a bearded man holding the trunk of a long tree over one shoulder. He is in a wide stance, legs bent and his body turned to lift the trunk. He is mostly naked with a small cloth hanging over one of his thighs and draping over his groin. He has pale skin with a muscular build, and he looks over his shoulder up to the right, his eyes wide and his mouth partially open. Armor pieces, including a helmet and shield or breastplate, are on the ground behind him, along with a long lance. A horse stands on the right behind the discarded armor, facing away from us, rearing up and turning its head back to look at the man. Slightly above center, two people are peek out from behind foliage, looking at the man. One of the people raises their arm over their head. The setting is a dense forest with large trees obscuring all most all of the gray sky, and the ground beneath the man is littered with small rocks and leaves.

artworks.title: Cherub
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate, symmetrical design featuring a cherubic face and floral motifs. The central figure of the design is a cherubic face adorned with wings emanating from the haloed head, appearing at the top center of the outlined, shield-like form. Around this face are elaborate floral motifs, including flowers, vines, and tendrils that create a balanced and decorative pattern. Two stylized scrolls or horns of plenty extend across the sides, overflowing with foliage. Towards the bottom section of the design, there's a central floral figure surrounded by more curling lines. The use of dark ink on a light background emphasizes the complexity and richness of the design.

artworks.title: Female Figure
artworks.description: This is a print of a symmetrical ornament decorated with several figures. In the lower center is the largest figure, who appears to be a human with wings. Their torso is bare, and they have no legs, but instead two swirling lines below their navel. This figure is surrounded by motifs like winged animals, scrolls, leaves, feathers, floral elements, and decorative swirls. Winged horses, the heads of lions, a bird, and a fish are distinguishable. The design is black, and the details are the tan color of the paper the print is on.

artworks.title: Griff
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of the head and upper torso of a person in profile. The person is leaning forward slightly with their head tilted downwards to the lower right corner. Their facial features include a prominent nose, downward-facing eyes, a bushy beard, and a receding hairline. They wear a garment with a high collar. The background is blank, emphasizing the pencil sketch of the individual.

artworks.title: Ernest Casimir, Count of Nassau-Dietz
artworks.artist: Willem Jacobsz Delff after Michiel van Miereveld
artworks.description: In this image, there is an illustrated portrait of a man in formal attire. He is shown in an official pose, looking directly at the viewer. The man has a full mustache and a small goatee, with wavy hair styled back. He wears an elaborate doublet with a high, lace collar and a breastplate underneath. The background is dark, and the portrait is framed by an oval border. Text below the image likely identifies the person depicted.
